tavern.name: The Drowned Rat
tavern.description: A low-beamed tavern smelling of woodsmoke and spilled ale. A long oak bar runs along one wall, a fire crackles in a stone hearth, and a creaking staircase climbs to the rooms above.

exits.description: The front door opens onto the village square.

tavern_rooms.name: Upstairs Rooms
tavern_rooms.description: A narrow hallway with four plain guest rooms. The floorboards groan underfoot and the window at the end looks out over the river.

exits.description: The staircase back down to the common room.

square.name: Village Square
square.description: A cobbled square around an old stone well. Market stalls line the edges, and roads lead off toward the river and the temple hill.

exits.description: The Drowned Rat's swinging sign hangs over the door.
A muddy lane slopes down to the river.
Steps climb the hill to the temple.

docks.name: River Docks
docks.description: Weathered wooden piers jut into the slow brown river. Fishing boats bob at their moorings and gulls squabble over scraps.

exits.description: Back up the lane to the square.

temple.name: Temple of the Tides
temple.description: A small whitewashed temple on the hilltop. Inside, candles flicker before a carved statue of the river goddess, and the air smells of incense.

exits.description: The steps lead back down to the square.

east_road.name: East Road
east_road.description: A rutted dirt road leaving the village between hedgerows and fields. A weathered milestone marks the edge of Riverton.
